goal: Implement the accepted model-routing redesign: stable family routes, centralized concrete versions, approved route order, permission-aware executability, passive infra health with TTLs, bounded fallback, migration aliases, cross-family architecture review, and complete removal of live Fable/Opus-4.8/Sol-architecture claims. Preserve unrelated dirty work and update only owed routing surfaces.
non_goals: Editing unrelated frontier-preparation or demo work

anchors.invariant: Approved route order and three-state semantics are fixed.
Carry deterministic author family, non-secret credential identity, migration compatibility at launcher boundary, and complete doc sweep.
One family registry owns concrete versions and stable route ids.
Human picks win; automatic selection preserves priority, skips degraded, and uses no more than two fallback hops.
Execution records passive infra health keyed without exposing credentials and never treats API-only chat as write-capable.

criteria: Fable, pinned Opus 4.8, and Sol architecture-review are absent from live routing.
Sonnet→Terra, Sol→Opus, Opus→Astra planning, and Opus-high→Astra→Grok-4.7 review orders are deterministic.
Stable route ids resolve concrete family versions and old ids remain one-release aliases.
Configured, permission-aware executable, and verified/unknown/degraded health states are distinct and tested with an injectable clock/store.
Human picks override health with warnings; automatic fallback is priority-preserving and capped at two hops.
API-key-only OpenAI routes are read-only; infra outcomes update health without logging credentials.
All live skills, references, ADRs, and learning/catalog claims reflect the new policy.
